note: The guide behind Main → How It Works. One paragraph per sidebar section and one line per item, rendered against config/navigation.json so every link on the page is a link the application answers. Edit the words here; the links come from the menu.
principle: Change configuration, not code. Every rule this product applies — attendance, leave, salary, statutory, approvals, letters, the menu itself — is a setting under Organization Setup with a version history, never a line of PHP. Every figure on a screen can show its own working.
laws: No business literal in code — every rate, slab and threshold is configuration.
No schema change while running — tables come from migrations only.
Nothing is overwritten — corrections supersede, with dates and names.
Every number explains itself — click a figure and it shows the working.
Authorisation is server-side and fails closed — a guard that is unsure says no.
Tenancy is structural — every row carries the tenant it belongs to.
Money is exact — decimals, never floats.

sections.main: Your day starts here: the dashboard, what you are owed so far this month, what is waiting on you, what is overdue on somebody else, and what the system has told you.
sections.hiring: From a vacancy to a first day: requisitions and candidates, a self-service onboarding form for the joiner, and verification of what they submitted.
sections.people: The employee register and everything that happens to one employee: probation, transfers, ID cards, documents, exit. Every change is a dated timeline event, never an overwrite.
sections.leave: Leave types, balances, requests and approvals under the leave policy the tenant publishes.
sections.payroll: Salary structures, runs, payslips and bank files — computed by the payroll engine from attendance and structure, with the derivation kept on every line.
sections.learning: Courses, tests and the knowledge base.
sections.letters: Appointment, confirmation, transfer and other letters rendered from editable templates against the employee record.
sections.field: Field staff: geo-fenced attendance and visit tracking.
sections.reports: Reports and analytics across the modules, each figure traceable to its rows.
sections.setup: Where the product is shaped for this company: fields, structure, formats, org units and every rule. Everything here is versioned; the old version stays readable.
sections.time: Punches from devices, uploads and manual entries are settled by the published attendance rules into one figure per day — the same figure the report, the muster and the payslip use.
sections.compensation: Expenses, advances, loans and other money requests through the approval workflow.
sections.statutory: Statutory registers and filings from signed content packs, blocked until a compliance owner signs the rates.
sections.admin: Users, roles, tenants, audit trail and health.

items.dashboard: KPIs and panels chosen in the dashboard configuration; each card links to the rows behind it.
items.live-salary: Running-month earnings till today: payable days settled so far, prorated against the month, through the same payroll engine as the payslip.
items.escalation-desk: Field/ops escalations register (date, company, bank, team, issue, severity, priority, status, action taken) with Add Escalation — and below it, approvals past their due-within with one button to put them in the approvers' Notifications.
items.inbox: Requests waiting on you to decide, and the ones you raised that wait on somebody else.
items.notifications: Everything the system queued for you — leave decisions, absence notices, escalations.
items.ai-assistant: Ask in plain words — who is absent today, my leave balance, pending approvals, where is a screen. Answered from this tenant's own data, inside your permissions; nothing leaves the server.
items.recruitment: Requisition → candidates → stages → interviews → hire, which creates the employee.
items.self-onboarding: Invite a joiner; they fill the form built from the enabled Employee Fields; HR verifies and injects the record.
items.employees: The directory: search, open, edit an employee; add one.
items.probation: Who is on probation, when it ends, confirm or extend — confirmation is a timeline event.
items.add-employee: The add form, driven by the enabled Employee Fields.
items.employee-import: CSV by field code → preview → commit; errors kept as a file.
items.transfers: Raise, approve by somebody else, applied on the effective date, transfer order letter.
items.id-cards: Print ID cards as PDF in the format designed under Organization Setup.
items.daily-attendance: One row per employee-day with the columns chosen under Organization Setup → Attendance report.
items.attendance-report: The muster grid: a letter per day, totals, drill-down, CSV.
items.manual-entry: Record a punch by hand; it settles like a device punch and says it was manual.
items.attendance-corrections: Regularisation requests, decided from one queue.
items.absence: Sweep a past date for no-punch, no-leave days and tell the person and their manager.
items.employee-fields: Which fields an employee has, their types, whether they are required, and which screens show them.
items.structure: Salary components and how they are computed; published in versions.
items.configure-attendance-report: Which columns the daily attendance report prints.
items.configure-id-card: What goes on the ID card, colours, size, orientation — with a live preview.
items.configuration: Every published rule set in one place, with history.
items.configure-menu: Rename, reorder or hide sidebar items. Hiding is not a permission.
items.devices: Register attendance devices of any make; ZKTeco pushes land under Pending Punches.
items.pending-punches: Punches received from devices that matched no employee yet.
items.shifts: Named shift timings; a night shift ends the next morning.
items.late-policy: Grace, free lates, the cut per extra late, and what a weekly-off day earns.
items.geofence-map: All geo-fence rules drawn on one map.
items.teams: Teams with their manager and leader; members are the employees whose record names the team.
items.exits: Exit record, clearance checklist, final clearance; FnF from the settlement.
items.onboarding-status: Each joiner's checklist; starts automatically on injection or transfer.
items.bgv: Per-check outcomes, overall status, re-verification due.
items.setup-holidays: The weekly-off pattern (every Sun, Sat+Sun, Sun + 1st and 4th Sat, any mix) and each year's holidays with type.
items.setup-leave-types: Leave types, and grants by company/branch/department/designation/team/employee that land on the ledgers.
items.setup-pay-cycles: Salary Schedule / Pay Cycle: rows scoped to a company, branch, department, designation, team or employee — cycle, attendance window (calendar, 21st–20th, custom From→To day), pay day. The most specific row wins and the payroll register takes each employee's window from it.
items.pay-cycles: Salary Schedule / Pay Cycle: rows scoped to a company, branch, department, designation, team or employee — cycle, attendance window (calendar, 21st–20th, custom From→To day), pay day. The most specific row wins and the payroll register takes each employee's window from it.
